_about: Generated by scripts/site/gen-plans.ts from deploy/cloudflare/src/plans.ts; do not edit. The checkout links are the ones GET /v1/plans gives.

free.free_key_note: An optional free key (emailed link, shown once, one active key per address) gives the same free limits on your own meter instead of one shared per IP address: 60 requests a minute and 25 registry lookups a day per key, 3 reports a month. The free keys used from one IP address together share at most 100 lookups a day.

paid_only.what: value history before the current roll year (registry_get, and the subject of registry_tx_equity_candidates)
paid_only.free: the current roll year only, and the answer says what was left out

paid_only.what: registry_get with as_of (a record as it stood on an earlier date)
registry_tx_equity_candidates with tax_year (a roll year you name)
paid_only.free: the newest roll year with values, without tax_year

paid_only.what: an owner's parcels beyond the first three (registry_owned_by)
paid_only.free: the first three parcels, and the number left out

paid_only.what: the registry batch tools registry_lookup_batch and registry_tx_equity_candidates_batch
paid_only.free: one parcel per call with the single-parcel tools

paid_only.what: the model-backed tools doc_extract_lease and report_narrative

paid_only_text: Six things on the hosted API need a Pro or Team key: value history before the current roll year (registry_get, and the subject of registry_tx_equity_candidates); registry_get with as_of (a record as it stood on an earlier date); registry_tx_equity_candidates with tax_year (a roll year you name); an owner's parcels beyond the first three (registry_owned_by); the registry batch tools registry_lookup_batch and registry_tx_equity_candidates_batch; and the model-backed tools doc_extract_lease and report_narrative.
lookup_counted: A lookup is one answered call to a registry_* tool: a record, a resolved ID, owners, or a search that ran inside loaded coverage (even with no results). Free: registry_coverage, input errors, misses outside loaded coverage (county, state, entity registry or ID system not loaded) and calls the registry could not answer.
